title: Three Foundation Pipeline Tracks
claim_boundary: These are supported pipeline directions, not three completed model-quality claims.
shared_principles: Keep target-side future labels and captions out of inputs unless the task explicitly queries them.
Report task-specific metrics and saved predictions before updating public cards.
Exclude raw private data and heavyweight base model weights from public packages.

tracks.title: Spatial intelligence models
tracks.question: Can the model recover and reason over space from video?
outputs: language answers grounded in the scene
tracks.first_pipeline: Build a spatial-memory exporter, start with metric depth and pose consistency tasks, then evaluate spatial QA, object permanence, counting, retrieval, and pose-aware consistency.
tracks.current_maturity: Ready as a pipeline and evaluation contract.
tracks.next_gate: Raw depth and pose artifacts plus held-out multi-episode spatial metrics.
avoid_claiming_now: general spatial intelligence without artifact-level evidence

tracks.title: Human-video world models
tracks.question: Can the model predict what happens next?
tracks.first_pipeline: Keep Qwen-style structured future probes for task interpretability, keep Cosmos-style dynamics branches separate, and add latent or feature-reconstruction metrics before claiming world-model quality.
tracks.current_maturity: Partially evidenced by current future-task probes and Cosmos-style branch artifacts.
tracks.next_gate: Stronger future-state metrics, qualitative future examples, and held-out episode breakdowns.
avoid_claiming_now: strong world model from structured future-task scores alone
visual future quality without visual or latent future metrics

tracks.title: Vision-language-action models
tracks.question: Can the model turn what it sees and reads into action?
tracks.first_pipeline: Define the action space, use existing 20-task next-action/contact/object-conditioned tasks first, then add hand-trajectory or policy-compatible action chunks after conversion is traceable.
tracks.current_maturity: Feasible but gated by action-target conversion.
tracks.next_gate: Traceable action tokens, normalization, retargeting metadata, and held-out policy metrics.
avoid_claiming_now: policy generalization before action-space evidence exists
